critiques.subject: City skyline at night with water reflections
critiques.mood: Urban, vibrant, and atmospheric with a moody nighttime ambiance
improvements: [MODERATE] Lift shadows by +15-20 in the mid-ground buildings to reveal architectural detail while preserving the deep blacks in the water and sky
[MODERATE] Apply selective sharpening to the skyline buildings and their reflections using masking, avoiding over-sharpening the lights
[MODERATE] Reduce luminance noise in the sky and darker water areas while preserving detail in lit areas
[SUBTLE] Apply graduated filter to darken and add contrast to the upper sky, creating stronger separation from the skyline
[SUBTLE] Slightly increase vibrance (+10-15) and reduce saturation on warm tones (-5) to balance the yellow-orange street lights with cooler building lights
preserve: The beautiful warm reflections in the water

critiques.notes: This is a solid night cityscape with excellent composition and attractive light reflections. The main opportunities are recovering detail in shadowed buildings without losing atmosphere, improving sharpness in the skyline, and managing the moderate noise present in darker areas. The warm color cast from street lighting is characteristic of nighttime urban photography and should be preserved while subtly balancing with cooler tones.
